{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Justrite 7210320 AccuFlow 1 Gallon, Galvanized Steel Type II Blue Safety Can With 5/8" Flexible Spout; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current need for a dedicated liquid safety can.
ItemID: NA; Title: Cyalume Glow Sticks Military Grade Lightstick - Premium Green 6” SnapLight Emergency Chemical Light Stick with 12 Hour Duration (Bulk Pack of 10 Chem Lights); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Emergency glow sticks do not address the repair and maintenance needs reflected in my recent purchases.
ItemID: NA; Title: Gorilla Super Glue 15 Gram, Clear, (Bulk Pack of 24); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Super glue fits my repair interests, but I would pass on a 24-pack without a specific need for that quantity.
ItemID: NA; Title: Gorilla Clear Grip Waterproof Contact Adhesive, , 3 Ounce, Clear, (Pack of 2); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for flexible waterproof repairs, given my previous use of Gorilla tape and vinyl cement.
ItemID: NA; Title: NEIKO 50432A Hex Nut Assortment Set | 150 Pc Nylon Locking Nuts | A3 Steel Hex Assorted Hardware Kit #10 & SAE | Metal Screw Nut for Bolts | Friction Lock Nut; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: This could suit mechanical repairs, but I would check the required thread sizes before buying.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wirefy Heat Shrink Tubing Kit - 3:1 Ratio Adhesive Lined, Marine Wire Shrink Wrap Tube - Waterproof Industrial, Automotive & Boat Tubes - Clear - 275 PCS; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this to insulate and protect wiring connections alongside the crimp terminals I previously bought.
ItemID: NA; Title: Supply Giant I33-10 PTFE Thread Seal Tape for Plumbers, White 1/2 Inch x 520 Inch (Pack of 10 Rolls), 10 Count; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Thread sealing tape could be useful, but hose clamp purchases alone do not establish a need for ten rolls.
ItemID: NA; Title: J-B Weld Original Epoxy, Steel Reinforced Epoxy, High Strength - 2 Pack, Dark Grey (8265S-2); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this for rigid repairs where tape or flexible adhesive would not provide enough strength.
ItemID: NA; Title: Dicor BT-1834-1 1/8" x 3/4" x 30' Butyl Seal Tape; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently have a specific sealing job that calls for butyl tape.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hillman 591521 Small Flat and Lock Washer Assortment, 270-Pack , Zinc; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Washers fit general maintenance work, but I would wait until I know which sizes a repair needs."}
